resolution_semantics.canonical_representative: A source-secure heterantherous taxon that can represent the Figure-2 family at an explicitly recorded provenance level.
resolution_semantics.exact_table_s1_identity: The exact species name printed in the inaccessible 2010 Supporting Table S1; this is an archival provenance question and is not required for current U3 matched-case identification.

evidence: Flora of North America / Hodgson Bixaceae treatment: Amoreuxia has two dimorphic fertile stamen sets
A. wrightii species description: distal filaments 5-10 mm with yellow anthers; proximal filaments 11-17 mm with usually dark-red anthers
2010 review explicitly treats former Cochlospermaceae within Bixaceae under APG III

Manning & Brothers 1986 directly describe marked heteranthery in Diascia anastrepta: the anticous anther pair is strongly reduced and produces little or no yellow pollen, while the posticous pair associated with the stigma produces copious grey-green pollen
Hilliard & Burtt 1983 provide the species-level taxonomic diagnosis before the 2010 review
Current Kew taxonomy retains Diascia anastrepta in Scrophulariaceae
Scrophulariaceae.selection_basis: Chosen as an independent pre-2010 family representative from direct species-level heteranthery evidence; this does not identify the inaccessible 2010 Table S1 row.

evidence: Darwin herbarium manuscript CUL-DAR110.B12: M. lepidota certainly has two stamen lengths within the same flower
Richard Spruce 1876-77 correspondence: M. lepidota is among Mollia species with five longer outer cohorts bearing green pollen and five shorter inner cohorts bearing yellow pollen
Maguire 1978 species treatment: five outer stamen phalanges about 2 cm long and five inner phalanges about 1.5 cm long
Current Kew taxonomy places Mollia lepidota in Malvaceae
Malvaceae.selection_basis: Chosen as an independent family representative because it has multiple species-specific pre-2010 morphology receipts; this does not identify the inaccessible 2010 Table S1 row.

legacy_field_note: The former pending_exact_representative_families field referred to missing independent family representatives, not exact Table-S1 archival identity.
